div.div:
AP management
The AP itself resides on VLAN 10. Management traffic is untagged on switch Port 3 with PVID 10.

div.div:
Guest controls
UniFi Client Device Isolation reduces same-VLAN wireless client-to-client communication.
Guest captive portal traffic is permitted to the Cloud Key on TCP 8880.
